purpose: Isolate optional semantic candidate ranking from token-packing changes, then quantify its evidence gains, losses and local costs.
runtime: The final committed runtime after output-preserving token-budget optimization; record its exact source SHA-256 and refuse resumed runs after any runtime or evaluator change.
candidate_policy: The already published fixed local MiniLM ONNX model, complete overlapping windows, scope-before-ranking, equal-weight RRF(k=60), 96 semantic candidate pages. No parameter choice from heldout outcomes.

execution: Both modes share the same indexed archive, runtime and assembly. Alternate lexical/semantic order by query position and repetition; deterministic seed+1009*repetition query permutation. Perform explicit model loading and indexing before measurements. Commit a SQLite attempt before each recall and the measured result afterwards. Preserve interrupted/failed attempts; resume only with identical source, evaluator, data, model, package and configuration identities. Source text stays in ignored .artifacts. Publish per-query source/context/block hashes, evidence ranks, all repetition timings and paired gains/losses.

diagnostics.low_lexical_overlap_le_0.25: At most 25% of unique normalized query terms (existing stopword/CJK-bigram lexical analysis) occur in the union of the required evidence text. Computed only evaluator-side; does not control retrieval.
diagnostics.cross_session: Required annotations address at least two distinct original sessions
diagnostics.cross_chapter: Required annotations map to at least two actual indexed chapter IDs. Report separately from within-session multi_section categories.

cost_boundary: Separate once-per-corpus ingestion, model loading, index build and vector bytes from each uncached recall. Query latency excludes scoring/checkpoint I/O. First-pass costs occur after explicit model loading/indexing and are not OS/disk-cold. If resumed, retain process segments, additional model loads, incomplete preparation attempts and unknown interrupted costs. Book's configured summaries are extractive and make zero model calls. No provider-bill, electricity or full-competitor-workflow claim.
methodology: Evidence retrieval only. Both modes have identical 8000-character caps, exact cl100k_base token caps, top-five page limits and source-preserving assembly. Semantic changes rankings and may lose lexical evidence; report every gain and loss. Labels stay evaluator-side and never enter index/ranking/packing. Report budget, source-span, project-scope, metadata, source-stability and repeated-output invariants. Existing public/synthetic/authored sets are regression data; Hotpot128 is a bounded scoped-distractor multi-hop corpus, not full-Wikipedia or conversational-memory generalization. Model pretraining overlap is unknown. One model, six authored domains and one external corpus cannot establish universal semantic memory or final-answer accuracy. A worse or slower semantic candidate is retained and documented, not tuned on this cohort or silently dropped.
